common.disabled: The admin interface is not enabled (ADMIN_USER_1…5).

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.description: Manage orders, products and stock, customers, coupons and the newsletter.
login.disabledBefore: The admin interface is not enabled. Set at least one
login.disabledAfter: environment variable (in username:password form, password at least 12 characters) in the environment's .env file, then restart the server.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts, please wait a few minutes.
login.invalidCaptcha: Wrong or expired security answer, please try again.

grid.resizeHint: Drag to resize the column (double-click: default width)

orders.title: Orders
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search: order number, name, email, tracking or invoice number

detail.markPaidConfirm: Record that the payment has arrived? The customer will receive a notification email.
detail.markPaidFailed: This order cannot be marked as paid.
detail.notePlaceholder: Note (also shown in the shipping email)
detail.shipHint: On shipping, the customer receives an email with the tracking number and link.
detail.cancelConfirmText: Stock reserved by the order is returned. The customer gets no automatic email; any refund must be handled separately.
detail.internalNoteHint: Visible to admins only, never to the customer.
detail.invoiceIssueText: The invoice is created on Számlázz.hu and, depending on the settings, emailed to the customer. An issued invoice can only be voided with a cancellation invoice.
detail.invoiceManualPlaceholder: Number of an invoice issued elsewhere
detail.invoiceNotConfigured: Set the SZAMLAZZ_AGENT_KEY environment variable for automatic invoicing; until then you can record the number of an invoice issued elsewhere.
detail.invoiceClearText: Only the invoice number stored in the webshop is removed; this does not void the invoice in the invoicing system.

invoiceErrors.alreadyIssued: This order already has an invoice.
invoiceErrors.canceled: No invoice can be issued for a cancelled order.
invoiceErrors.invalidNumber: The invoice number may only contain letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, slashes, dots and underscores.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.newDescription: Fixed-amount discount on the product price (shipping is not affected). Validity is by day, the start and end days are included; leave empty for no limit.

errors.codeTooShort: The code must be at least 3 characters (letters, digits, hyphen).
errors.invalidAmount: The discount must be a positive whole forint amount.
errors.invalidDate: Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.invalidRange: The start date cannot be after the end date.

newsletter.title: Newsletter subscribers
newsletter.disabledTitle: The admin interface is not enabled
newsletter.disabledText: Set the ADMIN_USER_1…5 environment variable (at least 12 characters) in the environment's .env file, then restart the server.
newsletter.hint: Newsletters may only be sent to “Active” (confirmed) addresses. Import the CSV into your newsletter provider; delete or mark here anyone who unsubscribed there.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings are saved to your user and apply whichever device you sign in from.
settings.pageSizeHint: Number of rows shown per page in lists.

backups.title: Database backup
backups.description: Automatic backup every {hours} hours; the latest {keep} automatic backups are kept (BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS, BACKUP_KEEP). Manual backups are never deleted automatically.
backups.none: No backup yet (the first automatic backup is made a few minutes after the server starts).
backups.hint: A backup is the full customer database including personal data: store it securely only. Backups also stay on the server, so download one regularly to protect against server failure.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.noteRevenue: Revenue is the total of non-cancelled orders (including shipping and cash-on-delivery fees), in Budapest time.
dashboard.chartAria: Bar chart: daily revenue over the last 30 days

products.title: Products & stock
products.description: Set price, availability, featuring and stock here. All other product data (description, image, translations) lives in products.json. Changes appear in the webshop within half a minute.
products.stockHint: Empty price: the base price from products.json applies. Empty stock: not tracked, unlimited orders. At 0 the variant is “Sold out” and cannot be ordered. Stock decreases on order and is restored on cancellation.

errors.invalidPrice: The price must be a positive whole number (or empty for the base price).
errors.invalidStock: Stock must be a non-negative whole number (or empty).
errors.lastActive: At least one orderable product and variant must remain.

customers.title: Customers
customers.disableConfirmText: The customer is signed out and cannot sign in until you enable the account again. They can still order as a guest.
customers.enableConfirmText: The customer can sign in to their account again.
customers.anonymizeConfirmText: Name, email, phone and address are erased from the customer and their orders; the account and newsletter subscription are removed. Order totals and items are kept. This cannot be undone.
customers.hasInvoices: Note: {count} of their orders have issued invoices. Invoice data must be kept in the invoicing system for the statutory retention period (8 years).

audit.title: Activity log
audit.description: Changes made by admins: who changed what and when (latest 1000 entries).
